aria2 / aria2c
Version: 1.37.0
Upstream: https://github.com/aria2/aria2
Android release asset: aria2-1.37.0-aarch64-linux-android-build1.zip

The Android firmware download path invokes the official upstream aria2c executable directly.
It is not a reimplementation or behavioral clone.
